name: Ninja X
summary: Welcome to Ninja Training, the ultimate Mixed Reality experience. Engage in a series of immersive challenges designed to test and sharpen your ninja skills. Navigate through obstacle courses, master stealth techniques, and engage in intense combat simulations. With stunning AR visuals and intuitive hand tracking, Ninja Training offers a realistic and exhilarating journey to becoming a ninja warrior. Train hard, outsmart your opponents, and rise to the top.
